module: Selection cache of the Easy Select tool. It only rebuilds the selection data (list of projected "proxies") once the camera has been still for 0.12 s, or after an invalidation or a configuration change. Possible states: waiting, moving, building, ready.
notes: The camera is compared with the previous one (position, rangeOrigin, forward, up, halfTan, width/height); the slightest change resets the state to "moving" and deletes the data.
Times are measured with hptimer; buildTime is the value returned by timer:stopAndReset() (seconds or ms depending on hptimer, not specified here).

activate.desc: Completely resets the cache state (status waiting).

invalidate.desc: Deletes the cached data and restarts the stabilization delay.

update.desc: To be called every frame. Returns nil while the camera is moving, the configuration has just changed or the 0.12 s delay has not elapsed; then calls build() only once and returns its data, then returns them as-is.

camera.desc: Camera context (pos, rangeOrigin, forward, up, halfTan, width, height)

configKey.desc: Configuration key; if it changes, the cache is invalidated (reason "settings")

build.desc: Function with no arguments that builds the data (expects a table that may contain proxies)

returns.desc: Built data or nil if not ready

setClassificationTime.desc: Records the classification duration for the debug display.

getStatus.desc: Returns a snapshot of the cache state for debug.

returns.desc: {status, reason, targetCount (number of proxies), buildTime, classificationTime}
